key_impacts: Harbor walls were overtopped and breakwalls submerged, flooding shoreline and city streets.
Damage to shoreline homes, public docks, cottages, and boat docks reported.
Water intake pumps were impacted by rapid water-level changes.
Water level fluctuations up to 0.5 m at the harbor gauge and about 2 m just outside the harbor.
evidence_snippets: On April 13, 2018, meteotsunami waves struck the shores near Ludington, Michigan.
Harbor walls were overtopped; damage to shoreline homes and boat docks; water intake pumps were impacted.
Water level fluctuations up to 0.5 m at the harbor gauge; 2 m along the coastline outside the harbor.
missing_information: Exact counts of damaged structures and monetary losses not provided.
